I retrieved the HIST120-U4 trade routes content. I then retrieved it a second time to make sure nothing had changed, and the result was identical. After that I pulled the four course learning objectives and built the quiz. The quiz has 10 questions worth 40 marks in total. Q1–3 are multiple choice on networks and goods (LO-1, 8 marks). Q4–5 are short answers on monsoon winds and camel caravans (LO-2, 10 marks). Q6–8 are short answers on the spread of Buddhism and Islam (LO-3, 10 marks). Q9–10 form an evidence-based extended response on the benefits and costs of exchange, including plague diffusion (LO-4, 12 marks). The answer key gives the correct MCQ options and model responses tied to sections U4.1–U4.4. The marking rubric uses 4 bands for the short and extended answers (Excellent, Proficient, Developing, Beginning), with descriptors for accuracy, use of evidence and causal reasoning, and it roughly follows the course weighting.
